name: pr-delivery
description: End-to-end pull request delivery workflow for GitHub and Forgejo repositories.

interface.shortDescription: Ship, monitor, merge, verify CI, and clean up PRs.
interface.longDescription: End-to-end pull request delivery workflow for GitHub and Forgejo repositories. Covers commit, push, PR creation, CI and review monitoring, safe merge, ancestry verification, optional target-branch CI verification, and cleanup.
defaultPrompt: Use $pr-delivery to deliver this branch through a PR.
Open or update the PR, monitor checks, merge safely, verify target-branch CI, and clean up.
Address PR feedback and failed checks, then complete delivery.
